title: A New Global News Editor in New York
body_markdown:
Caroline Houck, a collaborative and innovative editor, is International’s new global news editor in New York. Read more from the International team below.


In our search for our next global news editor in New York, we wanted an innovative editor with a command of our daily news priorities, a deep understanding of our digital audience and the ability to work across hubs with grace and equanimity. We are pleased to announce that we have found that leader: Caroline Houck will step into the role to drive our news agenda around the world, working closely with Alison, International’s news director.


Since joining The Times as a senior staff editor in 2024, Caroline has edited a wide range of major international news. She helped run live coverage of the war in Iran and the


[June peace framework](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/06/14/world/iran-war-trump-us) , the


[American intervention in Venezuela](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/01/03/world/trump-maduro-venezuela-us-strikes) and the earthquakes there, and more. She has already shown her judgment and creativity while filling in as global news editor on day, night and weekend shifts, often with a “Yes, and …” attitude and a talent for handling whatever we put in front of her. She’s also been a valuable partner on projects in every hub, demonstrating the power of collaboration at The Times.


Caroline came to The Times from Vox, where she launched and oversaw its flagship daily morning newsletter,


[Today, Explained](https://www.vox.com/pages/today-explained) . Before that, she ran Vox’s international coverage, on topics including the war in Ukraine and the


[Israel-Hamas war](https://www.vox.com/2023/10/7/23907683/israel-hamas-war-news-updates-october-2023) , helping deliver


[approachable explainers](https://www.vox.com/world-politics/23910641/israel-hamas-war-gaza-palestine-explainer) and creative


[multimedia interactives](https://www.vox.com/c/world-politics/2023/5/10/23630754/russia-ukraine-war-kharkiv-city-transformed) .


She began her journalism career reporting for


[Defense One](https://www.defenseone.com/voices/caroline-houck/12277/) and


[freelancing abroad](https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/in-nicaragua-a-town-of-fighters-is-at-the-heart-of-an-intensifying-crisis/2018/06/23/7b54163c-764b-11e8-bda1-18e53a448a14_story.html) . She loves playing poker, dancing salsa, and hiking along craggy mountains and sunny beaches alike.


Please join us in congratulating Caroline.


Philip Pan, Greg Winter and Alison Mitchell
